description.content:
SSE endpoint: stream agent response chunks for the given message in a conversation.
Client must pass the message_id returned by POST /messages/streaming to avoid races
with "latest message" lookups.

List all tools available from an MCP server configuration.

Accepts the MCP config DTO directly in the request body.

Get a list of all conversations for the current user.

Args:
    request: FastAPI Request object containing headers
    
Returns:
    List[Dict]: List of conversations with basic details (id, thread_id, name)

Create a new conversation.

Args:
    request: FastAPI Request object containing headers
    data: Request body containing thread_id and name
    
Returns:
    Dict containing the created conversation details

Update the name of a conversation.

Args:
    request: FastAPI Request object containing headers
    thread_id: The ID of the conversation thread to update
    data: Request body containing the new name
    
Returns:
    Dict containing the updated conversation details

Delete a conversation by thread ID.

Args:
    request: FastAPI Request object containing headers
    thread_id: The ID of the conversation thread to delete
    
Returns:
    Dict containing the status of the deletion

Get the current state of a chat conversation.

Args:
    request: FastAPI Request object containing headers
    thread_id: The ID of the conversation thread
    
Returns:
    Dict containing the current state of the conversation
Sync a specific workspace to the vector store by its workspace_id.
Reset the vector store by clearing all stored documents.
Advanced search resources using Vespa with filtering and ranking.

custom-agent, and python-agent.
Downloads data files as a zip file, or single file directly from S3

Args:
    agent_type: "jira-agent-v2", "hubspot-agent-v2", "atlassian-agent", "fellow-agent-v2",
        "custom-agent", or "python-agent"
    body: Request containing list of file paths and optional workspaceId
